note: Kern County park ~25 mi SW of Bakersfield on a horseshoe spit between Lake Webb (powerboats, jet-skis) and Lake Evans (5 mph). Its 112 sites sit in a double row, priced by waterfront and by utilities. Sprinklers water the grounds, so gear goes in designated spots. Three boat launches and a dump station. --Claude
summary: Kern County pages read (browser): $16-40 by season, waterfront and utilities, $8 reservation, $12 second vehicle, 10 people, 14 nights peak / 31 off-peak, 30/50 A, year-round, online (Camava) or phone. Lakefront kept (outer-row pads 12-22 m from the water, ~1.1 m above it).
flags: WATERFRONT: stored 'lakefront' kept. The county sells a 'Waterfront Campsite' class. The outer-row pads sit between the perimeter road and the shore, e.g. the west-shore pads at 35.22733,-119.26350 and 35.22663,-119.26320, which are 12-15 m from Lake Webb over open ground with no road between. 3DEP puts those pads ~1.1 m above the water (91.3 -> 90.2 m), so the kayak test passes. The waterfront sites are bookable by the night. Site numbers weren't read: the county's campsite-map PDFs returned 403 even inside the browser context.
PHONE: 661-868-7000 confirmed (Parks reservation desk); the gate office is 661-868-7025. WEBSITE confirmed. The page answers 403 to plain curl but reads in the headless browser.
FIT: no rig length posted; nothing singles out small rigs. Sewer and showers are left as stored. The pages I read confirm the 30/50 A plug-ins and the dump station but don't mention sewer or showers.
